result.document_summary: A middle fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3, covering sidewalk vending reporting, the real property documentary transfer tax, and the transient vehicle rental tax, with no residential rental rules in the six categories.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in the six in-scope categories. It covers sidewalk vending reporting requirements (§36.0116), the Real Property Transfer Tax Ordinance (Art. 7), and the Transient Transportation Tax on vehicle rentals (Art. 8). The page URL points to the algorithmic rent-setting ban (SDMC §98.1103), but that text is not included in this part, so no rule is extracted.
